# Ali Hamza Studio

> Ali Hamza Studio is run by Ali Hamza, a full-stack web and app developer based in Islamabad, Pakistan, working with small businesses in the US and worldwide. He builds business websites, booking and ordering apps, custom CRMs and admin dashboards, and e-commerce stores. Projects start at $500 with a fixed written quote.

## Services

- [Business websites](https://alihamzamughal.dev/#services): Mobile-first sites with local SEO, built on WordPress or Next.js.
- [Booking & ordering apps](https://alihamzamughal.dev/#services): Appointment booking, restaurant ordering, meal-prep subscriptions, reminders.
- [CRMs & admin dashboards](https://alihamzamughal.dev/#services): Customer, quote, and order records, staff roles, notifications, customer portals.
- [E-commerce stores](https://alihamzamughal.dev/#services): Shopify and WooCommerce development and audits.
- [Pricing](https://alihamzamughal.dev/#pricing): Websites from $500; apps and CRMs quoted per project.

## Work

- [All projects](https://alihamzamughal.dev/work): Perfection Auto Spa, Luna Pizza Kitchen, Medimil, Habibi's Carbon, Pinion Newswire, The Brainiacs School.
- [Budget Auto Fix AI Assistant](https://github.com/hamzadoescoding/budget-autofix-ai-assistant): Public prototype of an automotive booking assistant using sample data.
